name: 双女 · 编发
description: 一个女孩坐在另一个身后给她编头发（擦边）
pose_tags: sitting, looking away, braiding hair, fingers in hair, hair brush
pose_nl: one girl sits behind the other and gathers her hair into a braid. her fingers separate the strands and weave them over each other. the girl in front sits still with her back turned. seen from behind and slightly above with both of them in frame.
